title: Burrow Reach
text: Terraces in the east, steps of soil each exactly as high as the last. Holes everywhere, each the width of a Burrower. Four nests on the edges of the map, and the ground between them busy. It is the worst place on the planet we've seen to make camp, and the richest.

lines.text: "Defences first. Then go and look at those furrows. Something about the radar picture is wrong. It's too right."
